items.t: KKR Commits to Hire 250,000 Veterans and Military Spouses Across Its Portfolio in Recognition of America’s 250th Anniversary
items.sum: NEW YORK, November 11, 2026--In recognition of Veterans Day and the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States, KKR, a leading global investment firm, announced a goal today to hire 250,000 veterans and military spouses across its portfolio by 2040.

items.t: KKR (KKR) Keeps Minority Interest In Canopius After Majority Stake Deal
items.sum: KKR (NYSE:KKR) plans to sell a majority stake in specialty insurer Canopius to Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance, while keeping a minority holding. The Canopius deal links KKR with a large Asian insurance partner, creating scope for future collaboration across underwriting and capital solutions.
